body.heading: Build the walls
paragraphs: Drape blankets over chairs with your adult's help. Cushions make good walls and doors.
Test that your fort stands up when you crawl in and out. Architects always test.

body.heading: Move in
paragraphs: Make a sign for your fort and hang it by the door. Bring in a book and a torch.
Read a story inside your fort. Everything feels more like an adventure in there.

takeaway: A few blankets can turn an ordinary room into a place of your own.
safetyNotes: An adult checks the fort is steady, keeps the doorway clear, and nothing heavy goes on top.
screenFreeExtension: Draw a flag for your fort and invent the rules of your tiny village.
